changelog: **Practice interview with a stored after-action report (#2051):** mentees can rehearse a text-only interview on `/portal/goals` — `POST /api/interview-prep/session` starts one (MENTEE only, grounded in their target position or a requisition they are connected to, same rule as the CV review's tailoring) and `POST /api/interview-prep/session/[id]/turn` takes one typed answer and returns the interviewer's one-line observation and next question. A session is bounded at 6 answers; the sixth ends it with an after-action report on a fixed rubric (structure, evidence, relevance, clarity, 1–5) plus what went well, the two things to practise next and one rewritten answer, parsed with `safeParseModelJson` and stored as a PRIVATE `AiArtifact` the mentee may share with their mentor (enforced by the artefact routes; shared reports render on the mentor's view). New tenant model `PracticeSession` (orgId, `TENANT_MODELS`, cascades with the user) holds the transcript. Every typed answer, the role and the posting enter the prompt fenced as untrusted data; the interviewer's prompt carries the tone rules (challenging, never hostile; never comments on accent, appearance, name, age or background; no legal or immigration advice — redirect). Its own task id `practice_interview` (participant-side, free) makes the cost visible on `/admin/ai`. Text only: nothing touches a microphone or camera, asserted statically. Every denial is the same neutral "not available right now", and an unavailable provider stores nothing, so the typed answer stays in the box.

en: Practise a job interview for your target role by typing your answers, then get a private report on what went well and the two things to work on next — share it with your mentor if you like.
tr: Hedef rolün için yanıtlarını yazarak bir iş mülakatı provası yap, ardından neyin iyi gittiğini ve sırada üzerinde çalışman gereken iki şeyi gösteren özel bir rapor al — istersen mentorunla paylaş.
de: Übe ein Vorstellungsgespräch für deine Zielrolle, indem du deine Antworten tippst, und erhalte einen privaten Bericht, was gut lief und woran du als Nächstes arbeiten solltest — teile ihn, wenn du magst, mit deiner Mentorin oder deinem Mentor.
